engine.name: Kestra
engine.image_selection_reason: The official Docker Hub tag listing surfaced the full v2.0.3 image as a visible exact 2.x patch tag; availability of the v2.0.5 container image was not established by this audit. v2.0.5 is an upgrade verification item, not silently assumed.
engine.plugin_variant: Full image with bundled plugins; not slim/no-plugins

security_boundary.management_port_authentication: Not provided by default; loopback binding required
security_boundary.basic_auth: Enabled; credentials generated locally from ignored .env
security_boundary.arbitrary_script_flows: Blocked from committed flow templates until an isolated runner is specified and independently reviewed

required_next_gates: Verify official v2.0.5 Docker image availability and compare its release provenance before any upgrade.
Retain the CI evidence artifact showing the exact pulled image digests and health response.
Design and test a dedicated isolated task execution boundary before enabling script-based workflows.
Review GitHub integration permissions and side-effect restrictions before connecting any repository token.
Complete independent validation and certification as separate gates; no automated certification propagation.
